item.title: Congo's president warns next elections can't take place unless conflict is resolved
item.description: Congo’s president says the African nation won't be able to hold elections after his term ends in two years unless the conflict that has gripped the country’s east is resolved

item.title: Family fears for jailed Iranian Nobel Peace laureate's life if she's not moved to a Tehran hospital
item.description: Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi is in critical condition in an Iranian hospital

item.title: China is stepping up its Iran war diplomacy ahead of Trump's summit with Xi
item.description: China’s diplomatic role in the Iran war has come into sharper focus after talks between Chinese and Iranian foreign ministers on Wednesday, days before U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to meet his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping

item.title: Australian court rejects convicted murderer's appeal of deportation to small island nation
item.description: An Iranian man who murdered his wife has lost his landmark court bid to prevent Australia from sending him to live on a tiny Pacific island

item.title: Foreign visitors return to Jewish pilgrimage in Tunisia under tight security
item.description: The annual Jewish pilgrimage to the El-Ghriba Synagogue in Tunisia has seen a modest return of international visitors

item.title: Poland warns Russia is moving from low-cost recruits to professional sabotage cells
item.description: Poland's internal security service has warned that Russia is shifting from using individual recruits to ‘professional’ networks to carry out a campaign of sabotage across Europe
